headline: Banque du Caire Debuts on Egyptian Exchange After Record IPO
summary: Banque du Caire shares began trading on the Egyptian Exchange following a record EGP 36.37 billion initial public offering. The offering comprised over 6.86 billion shares, representing 45% of the bank's total equity.
why: Initial public offerings of major national banks provide important liquidity benchmarks for regional capital markets and broaden domestic share ownership.

impacts.name: Banque du Caire
impacts.why: The company's shares started trading publicly on the exchange following its IPO.
